svg.title: HyperWeave — unframed hero, light / Goethe Prism
svg.desc: HyperWeave hero banner, light: whisper laminar caustics with luminance-vignette edge fusion, faceted octahedral gem glyph (unseamed volume body, rim edge, glass cushion window, vertex nodes, no interior cross) scaled to bracket a wordmark and subtitle placed by weighted optical centre, all three flush to a single left axis.

hw:chromatic.theory: goethe prism edges — magenta against cyan, CMY print heritage

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Third pass: the lockup was undersized for a 1200x300 field and the mark sat on the wordmark cap while the subtitle hung below it, dragging the type block's optical centre 32px under the mark's. v3 scales the whole composition up and re-solves the vertical on the full type block.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Two separate errors were being felt as one. The size error: the earlier build treated the vignette bands as a hard boundary the mark could not cross, but the vignettes render inside the background group and the lockup draws on top of them — nothing was ever being clipped, so the mark had ~40px of headroom it was not using. Mark goes 0.98 to 1.20 (192px tall on a 300px band), wordmark 1.45 to 1.58, and the two grow at different rates so the mark-to-cap ratio widens from 2.08 to 2.34 rather than freezing the old imbalance at a larger size. The balance error: the mark now centres on the canvas midline at y150 while the type block is placed by weighted optical centre — cap block at 0.72, subtitle at 0.28 — which lands the cap top at 81.2 and the subtitle baseline at 227.4, both nested inside the mark's 54-246 span so the diamond brackets the type instead of sitting beside it. Horizontal margins solve to 50 left (a diamond point) against 77 right (a letter stem), asymmetric by measure and even by eye. Facet ramp deepens 0.10/0.22/0.34 to 0.13/0.27/0.41 and the rim goes to full opacity, buying the enlarged mark the mass to hold its side against solid ink type.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: The mark now occupies 64 percent of canvas height and the wordmark runs to x1122.6, so this is a full-bleed lockup with 4-6 percent margins — confident at hero scale, but it leaves no room for a badge, nav, or CTA if the banner ever has to host one; a boxed or padded variant would need its own emission rather than a crop of this. Vignette bands widened 64 to 72 top and bottom to give the enlarged tips calm ground, which is a deviation from the approved v3.5/v3.6 metrics and reverts in two attributes. Subtitle steps 16 to 17px with tracking 0.16 to 0.17em, so it grows slower than the wordmark and loses a little relative weight — deliberate, since the subtitle is a tail and pulling it up would re-create the bottom-heavy read v3 is fixing. The weighted centring constant (0.72/0.28) is judged, not measured; if the subtitle is ever shortened or dropped the mark wants to move back up toward the cap centre. Deepening the facets costs pool porosity — the caustics read through the crystal less than they did at 0.34. Reduced-motion still unresolved (CSS animation:none does not stop SMIL). Dark and adaptive emissions remain unbuilt.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: Mark translate(146,150) scale 1.20: spans x50-242, y54-246, half-extent 96. Wordmark translate(222.82,-724.6) scale 1.58: H flush x284, cap block 81.2-163.4 (height 82.16), right edge x1122.6, descender floor y189.6. Subtitle x284 y227.4 at 17px/0.17em, baseline gap 64 from the wordmark baseline. Mark-tip to H gap 42, holding the 0.437 gap-to-half-extent proportion from the approved lockup. Mark-height to cap-height ratio 2.34. Margins 50 left, 77.4 right, 54 top and bottom on the mark. Vignette sides 120, top and bottom 72. Glass window holds 44 percent of the diamond area.
